plainTranslation: Affection, generosity and enjoyment can still be present between the Person B (Venus) and Person A (Jupiter) people. The square can make their responses excessive or poorly matched: Person A (Jupiter)'s enthusiasm may encourage more indulgence than Person B (Venus) originally wanted, while Person B (Venus)'s enjoyment may encourage Person A (Jupiter) to keep expanding an offer or expectation. Spending, gifts and shared entertainment are possible expressions of this contact, not facts about the people. The difficulty is that a genuinely warm response can encourage more giving or enjoyment without establishing agreement about limits or priorities. The source makes some stronger claims conditional on planetary strength; without that chart information, the contact does not identify a habitual giver, a possessive person or someone who necessarily feels neglected.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
advice:
Let this person broaden your perspective without losing sight of your priorities. This connection works best when both people appreciate the opportunities in front of them while staying realistic.

The challenge is excess. Too much spending. Too much saying yes because the moment feels good. Too much relying on good feelings to carry the relationship instead of addressing what needs attention. This is where the connection needs honesty. Pleasure is not the problem. Avoidance is. Generosity is not the problem. Lack of limits is.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
